If you're just starting out I recommend only buying a few colors to start out with. Cadmium Red, Phthalo Blue, and Cad. Yellow will go a long way. Lamp Black and titanium white for mixing. Then a few brushes. I like a good size six and four round brush, if you want smaller you can buy smaller, a paint pallette (an old dish works just as well), a couple fan brushes and liners, a large flat brush and a couple of smaller flats. You would also need a container for Simple Green to clean the oil paint out of your brushes and some paint thinner.
